title: ProvenanceEdge v1
description: One edge connecting a CatalogEntry to the catalog page that linked it. A repository discovered through several catalogs keeps ONE entry and one SourcePin, with one ProvenanceEdge per origin.

sourceCatalogId.description: Stable id of the catalog page (the Awesome Testing list itself, or one of the 11 referenced catalogs).

depth.description: 1 = linked directly by the pinned Awesome Testing commit; 2 = linked by one of its referenced catalogs. Catalogs found at depth 2 are recorded, never expanded.

catalogCommit.description: Exact commit of the catalog source file that carried the link at resolution time.

urlAsLinked.description: The URL exactly as it appeared in the catalog, before any redirect resolution.
